version: TRDS comp versions as listed; graph 99c1930om_tmg (2025-09-15), comp map aa621124m_tmc (2026-10-07)
response_unit: dimensionless fraction, photon-counting; CCD/IR QE is a component
retrieval_instructions: Resolve the SYNPHOT obsmode to component files with the TRDS instrument graph: tmg=https://ssb.stsci.edu/trds/mtab/99c1930om_tmg.fits (cols COMPNAME,KEYWORD,INNODE,OUTNODE,THCOMPNAME), tmc=https://ssb.stsci.edu/trds/mtab/aa621124m_tmc.fits (COMPNAME->FILENAME,TIME). Component files: https://ssb.stsci.edu/trds/comp/<wfc3|acs|ota>/<name>_<ver>_syn.fits, BINTABLE WAVELENGTH [Angstrom], THROUGHPUT [dimensionless]. System = product of the components interpolated to a common grid, or stsynphot.band(obsmode) with PYSYN_CDBS pointing at a TRDS copy. Index of all versions: https://ssb.stsci.edu/trds/comp/<inst>/ ; omit mjd# for the reference curve.
search_notes: Searched STScI WFC3 throughput page, TRDS comp/ and mtab/ indexes, SVO metadata. SVO HST comment states curves are computed with stsynphot at reference epoch 2009-06-26 for WFC3.

source_name: NASA PDS Ring-Moon Systems Node Cassini ISS Calibration Volume COISS_0011 (ISS_NAC System Transmission)
response_unit: electrons/photon (Col 2: QE * optics * filter1 * filter2); Col 3 includes Solar Flux (phot cm^-2 s^-1 AA^-1 at 1 AU)
retrieval_instructions: GET directory index https://pds-rings.seti.org/holdings/volumes/COISS_0xxx/COISS_0011/calib/efficiency/systrans/ (or full tarball https://pds-rings.seti.org/holdings/volumes/COISS_0xxx/COISS_0011/calib/calib.tar.gz) with a User-Agent header. Select issna<filter1><filter2>_systrans.tab (parallel polarizer orientation) or *_b_systrans.tab (perpendicular polarizer orientation). Parse after '\begindata': Col 1 = Wavelength (nm, 0.1 nm grid), Col 2 = Transmitted Flux (QE * optics * filter1 * filter2). Do NOT use Col 3 (which multiplies by solarflux.tab). To derive paired filter transmission T(filter1)*T(filter2), restrict to valid overlapping support (200-1000 nm NAC, 390-1000 nm WAC) where QE*optics > 0, interpolate na_optics.tab and ccdqe.tab to the 0.1 nm grid, and divide Col 2 by (QE * optics); keep labeled as filter-pair transmission (including CL1 or CL2 when paired with clear).

Confirmed CISSCAL always uses paired systrans files and never separates CL1/CL2 from individual filters. C03 resolved: downgraded historical public_domain label to not_reviewed because inspected data headers/pages do not provide a blanket public-domain rights notice or prove all instrument-team contributions are US Government works.
